# ReadFile <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

</div>


```blitzbasic
ReadFile:Int32 filename:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `filename` | In | String | required | The file to open. |

**Returns:** A file handle, or 0 when the file does not exist, which you should always check.

## Description

Opens an existing file for reading, starting at its beginning.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print ReadFile("files_read_nothing_here")
```

```text
0
```
